```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(betterChromVAR)
  library(Matrix)
  library(BiocSingular)
  library(BiocNeighbors)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scater)
})
```

```{r}
f <- "GSE168851_scATAC_K562_TimeCourse_Peak_Matrix_SE.rds"
if(!file.exists(f)){
  options(timeout=10000)
  download.file("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE168nnn/GSE168851/suppl/GSE168851%5FscATAC%5FK562%5FTimeCourse%5FPeak%5FMatrix%5FSE%2Erds%2Egz",
                paste0(f,".gz"))
  R.utils::gunzip(paste0(f,".gz"))
}
```

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("GSE168851_scATAC_K562_TimeCourse_Peak_Matrix_SE.rds")
sce <- addGCBias(sce, BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
```

# scATACseq processing

```{r}
sce <- as(sce, "SingleCellExperiment")
assayNames(sce) <- "counts"

sce$libsize <- colSums(assay(sce))
sce <- sce[which(rowSums(assay(sce)>0L) >= 50),
           which(sce$libsize>=500)]
idf <- log1p(ncol(sce)/pmax(rowSums(assay(sce)), 1))
tfidf <- t(t(assay(sce)) / sce$libsize) * idf


set.seed(42)
svd_res <- runSVD(t(tfidf), k=20, BSPARAM=BiocSingular::IrlbaParam())

lsi <- svd_res$u %*% diag(svd_res$d, nrow=length(svd_res$d))
rownames(lsi) <- colnames(sce)
colnames(lsi) <- paste0("LSI_", seq_len(ncol(lsi)))

print(abs(stats::cor(lsi[, 1:3], sce$libsize)))

reducedDim(sce, "LSI") <- lsi

nn <- findKNN(lsi, k=20, BNPARAM=AnnoyParam(distance="Cosine"))
```

# betterChromVAR & smoothing

```{r}
if(file.exists("motif_ix.SE.rds")){
  motif_ix <- readRDS("motif_ix.SE.rds")
}else{
  library(motifmatchr)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  source("/common/scripts/getNonRedundantMotifs.R")
  motifs <- getNonRedundantMotifs("PWMatrix")
  motif_ix <- matchMotifs(motifs, sce, genome=BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  saveRDS(motif_ix, "motif_ix.SE.rds")
}

row.names(sce) <- as.character(granges(sce))
row.names(motif_ix) <- gsub(":+","",as.character(granges(motif_ix)),fixed=TRUE)
motif_ix <- motif_ix[row.names(sce),]
```

```{r}
dev <- betterChromVAR(sce, motif_ix)
```

```{r}
dev <- smoothDeviationsKNN(dev, nn)
```

```{r}
dev <- as(dev, "SingleCellExperiment")
reducedDims(dev) <- reducedDims(sce)
dev <- runUMAP(dev, dimred="LSI")
saveRDS(dev, file="devs.SE.rds")
```

# kNN-based methods

```{r}
bg <- getBackgroundKNN(sce, weights = "none")
dev2 <- computeDeviationsFromKNN(sce, bg, motif_ix)
assayNames(dev2) <- paste0("knn.",assayNames(dev2))
assays(dev) <- c(assays(dev), assays(dev2))
bg <- getBackgroundKNN(sce)
dev2 <- computeDeviationsFromKNN(sce, bg, motif_ix)
assayNames(dev2) <- paste0("knnW.",assayNames(dev2))
assays(dev) <- c(assays(dev), assays(dev2))
```


```{r}
saveRDS(dev, file="devs2.SE.rds")
```
